title: British Siblings, Winter Coats and Sailor Cap - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming full-length portrait of two young siblings standing hand-in-hand outdoors on a wooden boardwalk or plank path. The older girl wears a neat, dark double-breasted winter coat, stockings, gloves, and a curved brim bonnet, smiling at the camera. The younger boy stands playfully leaning to the side, wearing a dark buttoned jacket, loose trousers, and an angled sailor cap with a tally band. An open field with distant industrial or municipal buildings and utility poles stretches across the horizon under a clear sky, typical of the late 1930s to 1940s era when children's sailor-inspired fashion was widely popular.
